title: What I Shared in Paris
excerpt: It was a pleasure to be with the American Church in Paris a week or so ago. You can listen to my sermon here: https://www.acparis.org/worship-mission-63276/sermons2/1847-15-september-2019-lost And here are the slides from my Tuesday evening lecture. Can Christianity Survive?
body:
It was a pleasure to be with the American Church in Paris a week or so ago.

 You can listen to my sermon here:  https://www.acparis.org/worship-mission-63276/sermons2/1847-15-september-2019-lost

 And here are the slides from my Tuesday evening lecture.

 Can Christianity Survive?
